name: ClauseGuard MCP
tagline: Plain-English contract review, balanced Word Track Changes (.docx), draft comparison, and security questionnaires.
description: ClauseGuard helps founders, legal counsel, and deal desks review commercial agreements (MSAs, NDAs, SaaS subscriptions, data privacy addendums, and healthcare BAAs) against clear negotiation standards. It explains unusual clauses in plain English, drafts balanced revisions and fallback compromises, exports a ready-to-send Microsoft Word (.docx) file with native Track Changes, compares draft versions, and completes customer security questionnaires.

reviewer_test_credentials.mode: Zero-OTP Sandbox & Instant Pro Access Key
reviewer_test_credentials.instructions: Open https://clauseguard-mcp-production.up.railway.app/ to test any sample agreement immediately without OTPs, or pass X-ClauseGuard-Key: cg_pro_directory_reviewer_2026 for unlimited Pro access.

pricing.free_tier: 1 complimentary agreement review and Word Track Changes export per month
pricing.pro_tier: $49/mo for unlimited agreement reviews, custom redline exports, and security questionnaires

privacy_and_data_handling.data_retention: Zero model training on customer agreements. Document artifacts are held ephemerally in memory solely for your immediate Word (.docx) download.
privacy_and_data_handling.encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest

tools.name: compare_contract_versions
tools.title: Compare Agreement Drafts for Risk Shifts

test_prompts: Review this Master Services Agreement against our Balanced Buyer & Founder standard, explain the risky clauses in plain English, and prepare a Word .docx file with Track Changes.
Complete these 6 customer security questionnaire items covering SOC 2 Type II, encryption, subprocessor notice, and incident response timelines.
Compare our initial agreement draft against the counterparty's returned markup and highlight any changes that increase financial or legal exposure.
